1. Core Context & Background: One person has been arrested; the police are on the lookout for the other

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 26-year-old man was allegedly murdered by two men at Pallavaram on Thursday (November 19, 2026) night. A senior official from the Tambaram Police Commissionerate said the deceased, Akash, was a resident of Hasthinapuram near Chromepet and was working as a helper at the crematorium in Pallavaram. On Thursday, two people, Guru and Vimalraj, residents of Nagathamman Koil Street in Pallavaram, had come to the crematorium for a funeral procession. The police said that after the funeral procession at the crematorium, Guru and Vimalraj allegedly stole Akash’s mobile phone, following which an argument broke out between them. Later, the two men waited for Akash to come out of the crematorium and allegedly killed him with a knife.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Pallavaram police, after being alerted, sent Akash’s body to the Government Chengalpattu Hospital for a post-mortem examination. While the police have arrested Guru, a search is under way for Vimalraj.

articles.title: Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease payments, plots for assigned landowners in Amaravati
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land were taken over for the capital, mostly from Dalit and weaker sections, the union says

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Andhra Pradesh Agricultural Workers’ Union has demanded that the State government immediately pay annual lease amounts and allot residential and commercial plots to farmers who surrendered assigned lands for the construction of the capital at Amaravati. In a statement on Friday, union State president D. Ramadevi and general secretary K. Lokanadham said nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land had been taken over in the Amaravati region for capital development. Most of the beneficiaries of these lands belonged to poor Dalit and weaker sections, they said. The union leaders pointed out that the 2013 Land Acquisition Act provided for assigned landowners to receive the same rights and benefits as those holding patta lands, irrespective of whether the land was acquired through land pooling or compulsory acquisition. It alleged that the Central and State governments were violating the provisions of the law by denying assigned landowners their rightful entitlements. The leaders said that when Amaravati was established in 2014, assigned landowners had also surrendered their lands along with other farmers, based on assurances that they would receive annual lease payments and residential and commercial plots on a par with owners of patta lands. However, these assurances had not been fulfilled so far, they alleged. The landowners were facing severe livelihood difficulties as they had lost their agricultural land and had no alternative means of employment. The government had a responsibility to provide them relief at least by clearing the pending lease payments, the union leaders said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They demanded that the government immediately release the lease amounts and allot residential and commercial plots to all eligible assigned landowners. Warning of an agitation, they said the union would be compelled to launch protests if the government failed to address their demands.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease payments, plots for assigned landowners in Amaravati

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 03:00:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land were taken over for the capital, mostly from Dalit and weaker sections, the union says

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Andhra Pradesh Agricultural Workers’ Union has demanded that the State government immediately pay annual lease amounts and allot residential and commercial plots to farmers who surrendered assigned lands for the construction of the capital at Amaravati. In a statement on Friday, union State president D. Ramadevi and general secretary K. Lokanadham said nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land had been taken over in the Amaravati region for capital development. Most of the beneficiaries of these lands belonged to poor Dalit and weaker sections, they said. The union leaders pointed out that the 2013 Land Acquisition Act provided for assigned landowners to receive the same rights and benefits as those holding patta lands, irrespective of whether the land was acquired through land pooling or compulsory acquisition. It alleged that the Central and State governments were violating the provisions of the law by denying assigned landowners their rightful entitlements. The leaders said that when Amaravati was established in 2014, assigned landowners had also surrendered their lands along with other farmers, based on assurances that they would receive annual lease payments and residential and commercial plots on a par with owners of patta lands. However, these assurances had not been fulfilled so far, they alleged. The landowners were facing severe livelihood difficulties as they had lost their agricultural land and had no alternative means of employment. The government had a responsibility to provide them relief at least by clearing the pending lease payments, the union leaders said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They demanded that the government immediately release the lease amounts and allot residential and commercial plots to all eligible assigned landowners. Warning of an agitation, they said the union would be compelled to launch protests if the government failed to address their demands.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Construction (Noun)
निर्माण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Construction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Irrespective (Adjective)
निरपेक्ष — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Irrespective' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease payments, plots for assigned landowners in Amaravati", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land were taken over for the capital, mostly from Dalit and weaker sections, the union says.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease payments,' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease paymen' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease paymen' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land were taken over for the capital, mostly from Dalit and weaker sections, the union says." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Agricultural workers’ body seeks lease payments, plots for assigned landowners in Amaravati"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Warning of an agitation, they said the union would be compelled to launch protests if the government failed to address their demands.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Cyclone 'Akvan' LIVE: Odisha's coastal districts witness rough sea and strong winds as landfall begins
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Director of Bhubaneswar Meteorological Centre Manorama Mohanty said the duration of the landfall process would be a long process which could stretch over seven to eight hours

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to the Indian Meteorological Department, “The cyclonic storm “Akvan” Moved nearly north-northeastward with a speed of 24 kmph during the past 06 hrs and weakened into a deep depression at 1130 hrs IST of 20 Nov over south coastal Odisha. The Deep depression is likely to move north-northeastward and gradually weaken into a depression in the next 6 hours and a well-marked low-pressure area in the subsequent 6 hours. Ganjam Collector Keerthivasan on Cyclone Akvan, says, “Currently, the landfall process of the cyclone has reached its final stage, and the cyclone is also slowly losing its velocity and converting into a deep depression, which will further weaken into a depression going forward. indian meteorological department said that Cyclonic Storm “Akvan” over the west-central Bay of Bengal crossed the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coasts close to Gopalpur. Under its influence, isolated very heavy rainfall is likely over Odisha on 20th November. Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan is likely to cross the north Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, near Gopalpur, by noon on Friday (November 20, 2026), according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Odisha Assembly Speaker Surama Padhy on Friday (November 23) adjourned the proceedings of the House till November 23 morning due to Cyclone Akvan, which made landfall near Gopalpur during the day. The decision was taken at an all-party meeting, following which Padhy announced the adjournment. During the meeting, it was decided that legislators should assist people to overcome the adverse impact of Cyclone Akvan, she said. Odisha Assembly adjourned until November 23 morning due to Cyclone Akvan, with two-day recess for MLAs to assist affected constituencies.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan has begun interacting with the land along the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coast, bringing heavy rainfall and disrupting transport services.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Cyclone 'Akvan' LIVE: Odisha's coastal districts witness rough sea and strong winds as landfall begins

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 02:56:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Director of Bhubaneswar Meteorological Centre Manorama Mohanty said the duration of the landfall process would be a long process which could stretch over seven to eight hours

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: According to the Indian Meteorological Department, “The cyclonic storm “Akvan” Moved nearly north-northeastward with a speed of 24 kmph during the past 06 hrs and weakened into a deep depression at 1130 hrs IST of 20 Nov over south coastal Odisha. The Deep depression is likely to move north-northeastward and gradually weaken into a depression in the next 6 hours and a well-marked low-pressure area in the subsequent 6 hours. Ganjam Collector Keerthivasan on Cyclone Akvan, says, “Currently, the landfall process of the cyclone has reached its final stage, and the cyclone is also slowly losing its velocity and converting into a deep depression, which will further weaken into a depression going forward. indian meteorological department said that Cyclonic Storm “Akvan” over the west-central Bay of Bengal crossed the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coasts close to Gopalpur. Under its influence, isolated very heavy rainfall is likely over Odisha on 20th November. Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan is likely to cross the north Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, near Gopalpur, by noon on Friday (November 20, 2026), according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Odisha Assembly Speaker Surama Padhy on Friday (November 23) adjourned the proceedings of the House till November 23 morning due to Cyclone Akvan, which made landfall near Gopalpur during the day. The decision was taken at an all-party meeting, following which Padhy announced the adjournment. During the meeting, it was decided that legislators should assist people to overcome the adverse impact of Cyclone Akvan, she said. Odisha Assembly adjourned until November 23 morning due to Cyclone Akvan, with two-day recess for MLAs to assist affected constituencies.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan has begun interacting with the land along the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coast, bringing heavy rainfall and disrupting transport services.

articles.title: Supreme Court allows lighting of lamp on ‘Deepathoon’ at Thirupparankundram as limited one-time arrangement
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar however stayed the conclusive findings of the Madras HC in a January 6 judgment that upheld the right to light the lamp on the ‘Deepathoon’ as an essential practice

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Friday (November 20, 2026) allowed the lighting of the lamp, as a “limited one-time arrangement”, on the ‘Deepathoon’ at the Thirupparankundram Hill on Karthigai Deepam day (November 24, 2026). A Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar, however, stayed the conclusive findings of the Madras High Court in a January 6 judgment that upheld the right to light the lamp on the ‘Deepathoon’ as an essential practice. The court issued notice on the appeals filed by the State. The interim order dealt with pleas by the State to stay the January 6 judgment and also looked into the question whether the lamp could be lit on the ‘Deepathoon’ on the forthcoming Karthigai Deepam festival day falling on November 24. Pronouncing the interim order, Justice Kumar said the court was aware of the dangers of allowing once becoming a precedent, while also noting that two separate Benches of the High Court had allowed the lighting of the lamp. Imposing restrictions and safeguards, the Supreme Court directed that the Devasthanam would exclusively decide the members of the team to light the lamp on November 24. The Madurai District Collector would act as nodal officer for the event. The Commissioner of Madurai Police has to provide the ring of security. The Centre was directed to supplement security arrangements with CRPF personnel, if required. No procession, slogan-raising or permission to gathering of general public will be allowed, the court directed. The access to lamp-lighting would be allowed to only authorised persons.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The team would immediately leave the spot of the ‘Deepathoon’ after lighting the lamp without leaving behind any temporary or permanent installation or objects, the court ordered

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Supreme Court allows lighting of lamp on ‘Deepathoon’ at Thirupparankundram as limited one-time arrangement

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 02:54:03 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar however stayed the conclusive findings of the Madras HC in a January 6 judgment that upheld the right to light the lamp on the ‘Deepathoon’ as an essential practice

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Friday (November 20, 2026) allowed the lighting of the lamp, as a “limited one-time arrangement”, on the ‘Deepathoon’ at the Thirupparankundram Hill on Karthigai Deepam day (November 24, 2026). A Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar, however, stayed the conclusive findings of the Madras High Court in a January 6 judgment that upheld the right to light the lamp on the ‘Deepathoon’ as an essential practice. The court issued notice on the appeals filed by the State. The interim order dealt with pleas by the State to stay the January 6 judgment and also looked into the question whether the lamp could be lit on the ‘Deepathoon’ on the forthcoming Karthigai Deepam festival day falling on November 24. Pronouncing the interim order, Justice Kumar said the court was aware of the dangers of allowing once becoming a precedent, while also noting that two separate Benches of the High Court had allowed the lighting of the lamp. Imposing restrictions and safeguards, the Supreme Court directed that the Devasthanam would exclusively decide the members of the team to light the lamp on November 24. The Madurai District Collector would act as nodal officer for the event. The Commissioner of Madurai Police has to provide the ring of security. The Centre was directed to supplement security arrangements with CRPF personnel, if required. No procession, slogan-raising or permission to gathering of general public will be allowed, the court directed. The access to lamp-lighting would be allowed to only authorised persons.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The team would immediately leave the spot of the ‘Deepathoon’ after lighting the lamp without leaving behind any temporary or permanent installation or objects, the court ordered

articles.title: Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from FCI for market intervention in December
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Food and Civil Supplies Department has sanctioned the purchase at a cost of ₹59.75 crore, which will be met from the budgetary allocation under the relevant head for the 2026-27 financial year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Keralam government will procure 25,000 metric tonnes of rice from the Food Corporation of India (FCI) under the Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS) for distribution among ration card holders in December as part of its efforts to contain a possible increase in market prices. The Food and Civil Supplies Department has sanctioned the purchase at a cost of ₹59.75 crore, which will be met from the budgetary allocation under the relevant head for the 2026-27 financial year. Under the proposed distribution arrangement, non-priority ration card holders will receive five kg of either parboiled or raw rice per card, while priority category card holders will be given three kg of raw rice per card. The rice will be distributed at a subsidised rate of ₹27 a kg. Official sources point out that the intervention is necessary in view of the possibility of an increase in rice prices and demand in the state’s open market, especially during the festive season in December. Increasing the availability of rice in the market through the public distribution system would help contain price increases and ensure price stability, they said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The decision was taken on the basis of a detailed proposal submitted by the Commissioner of Civil Supplies.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from FCI for market intervention in December

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 02:50:50 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Food and Civil Supplies Department has sanctioned the purchase at a cost of ₹59.75 crore, which will be met from the budgetary allocation under the relevant head for the 2026-27 financial year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Keralam government will procure 25,000 metric tonnes of rice from the Food Corporation of India (FCI) under the Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS) for distribution among ration card holders in December as part of its efforts to contain a possible increase in market prices. The Food and Civil Supplies Department has sanctioned the purchase at a cost of ₹59.75 crore, which will be met from the budgetary allocation under the relevant head for the 2026-27 financial year. Under the proposed distribution arrangement, non-priority ration card holders will receive five kg of either parboiled or raw rice per card, while priority category card holders will be given three kg of raw rice per card. The rice will be distributed at a subsidised rate of ₹27 a kg. Official sources point out that the intervention is necessary in view of the possibility of an increase in rice prices and demand in the state’s open market, especially during the festive season in December. Increasing the availability of rice in the market through the public distribution system would help contain price increases and ensure price stability, they said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The decision was taken on the basis of a detailed proposal submitted by the Commissioner of Civil Supplies.

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Corporation (Noun)
निगम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Corporation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from FCI for market intervention in December", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Food and Civil Supplies Department has sanctioned the purchase at a cost of ₹59.75 crore, which will be met from the budgetary allocation under...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from FC' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Food and Civil Supplies Department has sanctioned the purchase at a cost of ₹59.75 crore, which will be met from the budgetary allocation under..." (Hinglish Arth: खाद्य और नागरिक आपूर्ति विभाग ने ₹59.75 करोड़ की लागत से खरीद को मंजूरी दे दी है, जिसे वित्तीय वर्ष 2026-27 के लिए संबंधित प्रमुख के तहत बजटीय आवंटन से पूरा किया जाएगा।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Keralam to procure 25,000 tonnes of rice from FCI for market intervention in December"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The decision was taken on the basis of a detailed proposal submitted by the Commissioner of Civil Supplies.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The decision was taken on the basis of a detailed proposal submitted by the Commissioner of Civil Supplies." (Hinglish Arth: यह निर्णय नागरिक आपूर्ति आयुक्त द्वारा प्रस्तुत एक विस्तृत प्रस्ताव के आधार पर लिया गया।)

articles.title: OPEC share in India’s crude imports drops to 27.4% in Apr-Oct amid West Asia flare-ups
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: During the mentioned period, India’s crude oil imports spurred about 2.7% to 146.6 million metric tonnes (MMT)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries’ (OPEC) share in India’s crude oil basket declined sharply to 27.4% during April-October of the current fiscal, against 38.5% in the corresponding period last year, according to the latest provisional data released by the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC). The decline potentially reflects a shift in India’s crude procurement strategy as the country navigates shipping disruptions and geopolitical uncertainties arising from the continuing conflict in West Asia. During the seven-month period, India’s crude oil imports increased 2.7% to 146.6 million metric tonnes (MMT). Without identifying individual countries, PPAC data showed that supplies from the Eurasian region accounted for 43.8% of India’s crude oil import basket, while the Middle East contributed 36%. South America accounted for 10.6% of imports, followed by Africa at 6.6% and North America at 3%. The changing sourcing pattern indicates a growing diversification of India’s crude oil procurement, with supplies from outside the traditional Middle Eastern market gaining a larger share. On the petroleum products trade front, diesel accounted for the largest share of India’s exports at 43.4% during the reported period. Petrol and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) followed with shares of 22.4% and 10%, respectively. On the import side, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) constituted the largest component, accounting for 50.5% of total petroleum product imports, followed by petroleum coke (petcoke) at 18.3%. Petroleum product exports remain an important component of India’s external energy trade to contain the impact on its net oil and gas import bill.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Further, PPAC data released on Wednesday showed that petroleum product export volumes declined 13.5% year-on-year during April-October, even as their export value increased approximately 47%.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #13 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 OPEC share in India’s crude imports drops to 27.4% in Apr-Oct amid West Asia flare-ups

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 10:15:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: During the mentioned period, India’s crude oil imports spurred about 2.7% to 146.6 million metric tonnes (MMT)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries’ (OPEC) share in India’s crude oil basket declined sharply to 27.4% during April-October of the current fiscal, against 38.5% in the corresponding period last year, according to the latest provisional data released by the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC). The decline potentially reflects a shift in India’s crude procurement strategy as the country navigates shipping disruptions and geopolitical uncertainties arising from the continuing conflict in West Asia. During the seven-month period, India’s crude oil imports increased 2.7% to 146.6 million metric tonnes (MMT). Without identifying individual countries, PPAC data showed that supplies from the Eurasian region accounted for 43.8% of India’s crude oil import basket, while the Middle East contributed 36%. South America accounted for 10.6% of imports, followed by Africa at 6.6% and North America at 3%. The changing sourcing pattern indicates a growing diversification of India’s crude oil procurement, with supplies from outside the traditional Middle Eastern market gaining a larger share. On the petroleum products trade front, diesel accounted for the largest share of India’s exports at 43.4% during the reported period. Petrol and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) followed with shares of 22.4% and 10%, respectively. On the import side, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) constituted the largest component, accounting for 50.5% of total petroleum product imports, followed by petroleum coke (petcoke) at 18.3%. Petroleum product exports remain an important component of India’s external energy trade to contain the impact on its net oil and gas import bill.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Further, PPAC data released on Wednesday showed that petroleum product export volumes declined 13.5% year-on-year during April-October, even as their export value increased approximately 47%.

Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।

✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Fiscal (Adjective)
राजकोषीय — सरकार की कुल कमाई (टैक्स) और कुल सरकारी खर्च (बजट) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Budgetary, Financial, Revenue-related  |  ✖ Ant: Non-financial, Private
Diversification (Noun)
विविधता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Diversification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, lower than target; cite feedstock shortage
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In the fiscal year 2025-26, OMCs had achieved an overall biodiesel blending of 0.18%

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s three state-owned oil marketing companies (OMCs) – Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation and Bharat Petroleum Corporation – achieved an overall biodiesel blending of just 0.08% in the first half of FY27, “significantly below” the indicative target of 5% by 2030, citing limited feedstock availability. Biodiesel is produced from various feedstocks, including non-edible vegetable oils, animal fat and recycled cooking oil. Between April and September 2026, the three OMCs sold approximately 4,900 crore litres of diesel. Of this, more than 4,700 crore litres were sold without any biodiesel blending. The remaining 200 crore litres comprised diesel blended with approximately four crore litres of biodiesel, translating into an average blending rate of 2% in the blended portion, they said in a joint statement. Consequently, biodiesel accounted for 0.08% of the total diesel sold by the OMCs during the six-month period. The performance also marks a decline from FY26, when the three companies achieved an overall biodiesel blending rate of 0.18%. The OMCs reiterated that biodiesel-blended diesel conforms to Bureau of Indian Standards specification BIS 1460, which prescribes requirements for automotive diesel fuel, and is covered under the publicly notified National Policy on Biofuels. They also pointed out that biodiesel blending is an established global practice, with countries such as Indonesia, Malaysia and Brazil adopting blending levels ranging from 10% to 50%, depending on feedstock availability.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: biofuels / diesel fuel / oil and gas - upstream activities / oil and gas - downstream activities / energy resources / energy and resource / biotechnology / agricultural research and technology

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #14 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, lower than target; cite feedstock shortage

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 09:12:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In the fiscal year 2025-26, OMCs had achieved an overall biodiesel blending of 0.18%

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s three state-owned oil marketing companies (OMCs) – Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation and Bharat Petroleum Corporation – achieved an overall biodiesel blending of just 0.08% in the first half of FY27, “significantly below” the indicative target of 5% by 2030, citing limited feedstock availability. Biodiesel is produced from various feedstocks, including non-edible vegetable oils, animal fat and recycled cooking oil. Between April and September 2026, the three OMCs sold approximately 4,900 crore litres of diesel. Of this, more than 4,700 crore litres were sold without any biodiesel blending. The remaining 200 crore litres comprised diesel blended with approximately four crore litres of biodiesel, translating into an average blending rate of 2% in the blended portion, they said in a joint statement. Consequently, biodiesel accounted for 0.08% of the total diesel sold by the OMCs during the six-month period. The performance also marks a decline from FY26, when the three companies achieved an overall biodiesel blending rate of 0.18%. The OMCs reiterated that biodiesel-blended diesel conforms to Bureau of Indian Standards specification BIS 1460, which prescribes requirements for automotive diesel fuel, and is covered under the publicly notified National Policy on Biofuels. They also pointed out that biodiesel blending is an established global practice, with countries such as Indonesia, Malaysia and Brazil adopting blending levels ranging from 10% to 50%, depending on feedstock availability.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: biofuels / diesel fuel / oil and gas - upstream activities / oil and gas - downstream activities / energy resources / energy and resource / biotechnology / agricultural research and technology

जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।

Fiscal (Adjective)
राजकोषीय — सरकार की कुल कमाई (टैक्स) और कुल सरकारी खर्च (बजट) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Budgetary, Financial, Revenue-related  |  ✖ Ant: Non-financial, Private
Specification (Noun)
विनिर्देश — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Specification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Availability (Noun)
उपलब्धता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Availability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, lower than target; cite feedstock shortage", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. In the fiscal year 2025-26, OMCs had achieved an overall biodiesel blending of 0.18%.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, low' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "In the fiscal year 2025-26, OMCs had achieved an overall biodiesel blending of 0.18%." (Hinglish Arth: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 में, ओएमसी ने 0.18% का समग्र बायोडीजल सम्मिश्रण हासिल किया था)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "OMCs achieve 0.08% biodiesel blending in H1, lower than target; cite feedstock shortage"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. biofuels / diesel fuel / oil and gas - upstream activities / oil and gas - downstream activities / energy resources / energy and resource /...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "biofuels / diesel fuel / oil and gas - upstream activities / oil and gas - downstream activities / energy resources / energy and resource /..." articles.title: How AI could reshape global growth and productivity
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an increase; what remains to be seen is how pervasive its impact will be across different sectors of the economy

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Many have likened the artificial intelligence (AI) phenomenon to the inventions of the steam engine or internal combustion engine in the 18th and 19th centuries, respectively. Only time can tell whether AI is epochal of that kind. In this two-part piece, we discuss the possible impact it may have on the global economy as a whole. A key impact of AI is considered to be an unprecedented rise in labour productivity. In fact, if there is one purpose AI is supposed to serve, it is enhancing labour productivity multifold. Since labour productivity is a key variable in this puzzle, consider what it constitutes of (Box 1) . It is a ratio of output and workers employed. Now this ratio can rise in three different ways — a rise in output for a given number of workers employed (rise in the numerator); a loss of jobs which leads to a fall in the denominator; more jobs are created, but the output rises faster than the jobs (while both the numerator and the denominator are rising, the numerator rises faster than the denominator). There is usually a distinction drawn between a case where there is a net loss of jobs versus one where jobs grow, but the output grows even faster. The latter is preferred over the former. Even though AI may displace white-collar workers, it may generate more jobs for the blue-collar workers, so in the net there may not be a job loss with AI adoption across the economy. However, for the argument we make below, it does not matter which of the three sources leads to a rise in productivity. Why should the rise in labour productivity matter? There are two contrasting takes on this question in the economics discipline. One which argues that productivity growth increases the growth of output in the economy. The idea is simple. Growth of output is a function of its two inputs — labour and capital. Since capital enhances the productivity of labour, the rate at which output can grow is the sum of the growth of the labour force and its productivity. So, if the workforce grows at 2% and productivity at 4%, the economy would stabilise at 6% growth over time. And if the rate of labour productivity rises, according to this framework, growth in the economy rises pari passu (Graph 1a). Between the three variables — output growth, labour growth and productivity growth — output growth adjusts to the other two. This is what Robert Solow, a celebrated economist and a Nobel laureate, showed in a seminal paper on growth theory. What he did not explain though was why and where did this labour productivity rise come from. Much later, his successors argued that the growth of labour productivity depends on investment in human capital, research and development, patent regimes, etc., what came to be known as endogenous growth theories.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कई लोगों ने कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) घटना की तुलना क्रमशः 18वीं और 19वीं शताब्दी में भाप इंजन या आंतरिक दहन इंजन के आविष्कारों से की है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intelligence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बुद्धिमत्ता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intelligence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Only time can tell whether AI is epochal of that kind.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — केवल समय ही बता सकता है कि एआई उस तरह का युगप्रवर्तक है या नहीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: In this two-part piece, we discuss the possible impact it may have on the global economy as a whole.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इस दो-भाग वाले भाग में, हम समग्र रूप से वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था पर पड़ने वाले संभावित प्रभाव पर चर्चा करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: A key impact of AI is considered to be an unprecedented rise in labour productivity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एआई का एक प्रमुख प्रभाव श्रम उत्पादकता में अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि माना जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: In fact, if there is one purpose AI is supposed to serve, it is enhancing labour productivity multifold.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वास्तव में, अगर एआई को एक उद्देश्य पूरा करना है, तो वह श्रम उत्पादकता को कई गुना बढ़ाना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Since labour productivity is a key variable in this puzzle, consider what it constitutes of (Box 1) .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — चूँकि इस पहेली में श्रम उत्पादकता एक प्रमुख चर है, इसलिए विचार करें कि इसका क्या मतलब है (बॉक्स 1)।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: It is a ratio of output and workers employed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह उत्पादन और नियोजित श्रमिकों का अनुपात है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Now this ratio can rise in three different ways — a rise in output for a given number of workers employed (rise in the numerator); a loss of jobs which leads to a fall in the denominator; more jobs are created, but the output rises faster than the jobs (while both the numerator and the denominator are rising, the numerator rises faster than the denominator).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अब यह अनुपात तीन अलग-अलग तरीकों से बढ़ सकता है - नियोजित श्रमिकों की एक निश्चित संख्या के लिए उत्पादन में वृद्धि (अंश में वृद्धि); नौकरियों का नुकसान जिसके कारण भाजक में गिरावट आती है; अधिक नौकरियाँ पैदा होती हैं, लेकिन उत्पादन नौकरियों की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ता है (जबकि अंश और हर दोनों बढ़ रहे हैं, अंश हर की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ता है)।।

hinglishTracks.en: There is usually a distinction drawn between a case where there is a net loss of jobs versus one where jobs grow, but the output grows even faster.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — आम तौर पर उन मामलों के बीच अंतर किया जाता है जहां नौकरियों का शुद्ध नुकसान होता है बनाम जहां नौकरियां बढ़ती हैं, लेकिन उत्पादन और भी तेजी से बढ़ता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The latter is preferred over the former.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पहले की तुलना में बाद वाले को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Even though AI may displace white-collar workers, it may generate more jobs for the blue-collar workers, so in the net there may not be a job loss with AI adoption across the economy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भले ही एआई सफेदपोश श्रमिकों को विस्थापित कर सकता है, यह ब्लू-कॉलर श्रमिकों के लिए अधिक नौकरियां पैदा कर सकता है, इसलिए पूरे अर्थव्यवस्था में एआई को अपनाने से नौकरी का नुकसान नहीं हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, for the argument we make below, it does not matter which of the three sources leads to a rise in productivity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि, हम नीचे जो तर्क दे रहे हैं, उससे कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता कि तीनों में से किस स्रोत से उत्पादकता में वृद्धि होती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Why should the rise in labour productivity matter?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — श्रम उत्पादकता में वृद्धि क्यों मायने रखनी चाहिए?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: There are two contrasting takes on this question in the economics discipline.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अर्थशास्त्र अनुशासन में इस प्रश्न पर दो विरोधाभासी दृष्टिकोण हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: One which argues that productivity growth increases the growth of output in the economy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एक जो तर्क देता है कि उत्पादकता वृद्धि अर्थव्यवस्था में उत्पादन की वृद्धि को बढ़ाती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The idea is simple.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विचार सरल है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Growth of output is a function of its two inputs — labour and capital.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उत्पादन की वृद्धि इसके दो आदानों - श्रम और पूंजी का एक कार्य है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Since capital enhances the productivity of labour, the rate at which output can grow is the sum of the growth of the labour force and its productivity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — चूँकि पूंजी श्रम की उत्पादकता को बढ़ाती है, जिस दर से उत्पादन बढ़ सकता है वह श्रम शक्ति की वृद्धि और उसकी उत्पादकता का योग है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: So, if the workforce grows at 2% and productivity at 4%, the economy would stabilise at 6% growth over time.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसलिए, यदि कार्यबल 2% और उत्पादकता 4% की दर से बढ़ती है, तो समय के साथ अर्थव्यवस्था 6% की वृद्धि पर स्थिर हो जाएगी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: And if the rate of labour productivity rises, according to this framework, growth in the economy rises pari passu (Graph 1a).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — और यदि श्रम उत्पादकता की दर बढ़ती है, तो इस ढांचे के अनुसार, अर्थव्यवस्था में वृद्धि समान रूप से बढ़ जाती है (ग्राफ़ 1ए)।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Between the three variables — output growth, labour growth and productivity growth — output growth adjusts to the other two.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — तीन चरों के बीच - उत्पादन वृद्धि, श्रम वृद्धि और उत्पादकता वृद्धि - उत्पादन वृद्धि अन्य दो के साथ समायोजित होती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: This is what Robert Solow, a celebrated economist and a Nobel laureate, showed in a seminal paper on growth theory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रसिद्ध अर्थशास्त्री और नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता रॉबर्ट सोलो ने विकास सिद्धांत पर एक मौलिक पेपर में यही दिखाया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: What he did not explain though was why and where did this labour productivity rise come from.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि उन्होंने यह नहीं बताया कि यह श्रम उत्पादकता में वृद्धि क्यों और कहाँ से हुई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #16 of 30 (18 NOV)

📰 How AI could reshape global growth and productivity

📌 Published: 18 Nov 2026, 11:54:05 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an increase; what remains to be seen is how pervasive its impact will be across different sectors of the economy

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Many have likened the artificial intelligence (AI) phenomenon to the inventions of the steam engine or internal combustion engine in the 18th and 19th centuries, respectively. Only time can tell whether AI is epochal of that kind. In this two-part piece, we discuss the possible impact it may have on the global economy as a whole. A key impact of AI is considered to be an unprecedented rise in labour productivity. In fact, if there is one purpose AI is supposed to serve, it is enhancing labour productivity multifold. Since labour productivity is a key variable in this puzzle, consider what it constitutes of (Box 1) . It is a ratio of output and workers employed. Now this ratio can rise in three different ways — a rise in output for a given number of workers employed (rise in the numerator); a loss of jobs which leads to a fall in the denominator; more jobs are created, but the output rises faster than the jobs (while both the numerator and the denominator are rising, the numerator rises faster than the denominator). There is usually a distinction drawn between a case where there is a net loss of jobs versus one where jobs grow, but the output grows even faster. The latter is preferred over the former. Even though AI may displace white-collar workers, it may generate more jobs for the blue-collar workers, so in the net there may not be a job loss with AI adoption across the economy. However, for the argument we make below, it does not matter which of the three sources leads to a rise in productivity. Why should the rise in labour productivity matter? There are two contrasting takes on this question in the economics discipline. One which argues that productivity growth increases the growth of output in the economy. The idea is simple. Growth of output is a function of its two inputs — labour and capital. Since capital enhances the productivity of labour, the rate at which output can grow is the sum of the growth of the labour force and its productivity. So, if the workforce grows at 2% and productivity at 4%, the economy would stabilise at 6% growth over time. And if the rate of labour productivity rises, according to this framework, growth in the economy rises pari passu (Graph 1a). Between the three variables — output growth, labour growth and productivity growth — output growth adjusts to the other two. This is what Robert Solow, a celebrated economist and a Nobel laureate, showed in a seminal paper on growth theory. What he did not explain though was why and where did this labour productivity rise come from. Much later, his successors argued that the growth of labour productivity depends on investment in human capital, research and development, patent regimes, etc., what came to be known as endogenous growth theories.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour

articles.title: India’s Oct. crude import bill soars 87.5% to $19.5-bn amid West Asia tensions, volumes up 11%
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While higher petroleum product exports offer a partial natural hedge, sustained increases in crude and gas prices could intensify pressure on the country’s import bill.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s crude oil import bill surged 87.5% year-on-year (YoY) to $19.5 billion in October, as elevated international benchmark prices, fuelled by renewed tensions in West Asia, sharply increased procurement costs. The increase came alongside an 11% rise in import volumes. The net import bill, calculated as imports of crude oil, petroleum products and natural gas less exports of petroleum products, rose 60% to $16 billion during the month, compared with $10 billion in October last year. Higher export realisations from petroleum products, however, provided some cushion against the escalating import burden. According to provisional data released by the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC), India imported 23.3 million metric tonnes (MMT) of crude oil in October, against 21 MMT in the corresponding month last year. The expenditure on crude imports, meanwhile, climbed to $19.5 billion from $10.4 billion, reflecting the disproportionate impact of higher international prices on the country’s energy import bill. The Indian crude oil basket averaged $119.91 per barrel in October, compared with $124.77 per barrel for Brent crude. In September, the Indian basket had averaged $116.09 per barrel, while Brent stood at $116.77 per barrel. The sustained increase in benchmark prices, amid continuing geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia, has left India exposed to higher energy procurement costs, given its dependence on imported crude oil. The impact of the rising crude import bill was partly offset by stronger earnings from petroleum product exports. India’s petroleum product exports increased 5.9% in volume terms to 5.4 MMT in October. However, export revenues surged approximately 91% to $6.3 billion.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The increase in export earnings provided an important buffer against the higher cost of crude procurement.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (18 NOV)

📰 India’s Oct. crude import bill soars 87.5% to $19.5-bn amid West Asia tensions, volumes up 11%

📌 Published: 18 Nov 2026, 10:23:00 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While higher petroleum product exports offer a partial natural hedge, sustained increases in crude and gas prices could intensify pressure on the country’s import bill.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s crude oil import bill surged 87.5% year-on-year (YoY) to $19.5 billion in October, as elevated international benchmark prices, fuelled by renewed tensions in West Asia, sharply increased procurement costs. The increase came alongside an 11% rise in import volumes. The net import bill, calculated as imports of crude oil, petroleum products and natural gas less exports of petroleum products, rose 60% to $16 billion during the month, compared with $10 billion in October last year. Higher export realisations from petroleum products, however, provided some cushion against the escalating import burden. According to provisional data released by the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC), India imported 23.3 million metric tonnes (MMT) of crude oil in October, against 21 MMT in the corresponding month last year. The expenditure on crude imports, meanwhile, climbed to $19.5 billion from $10.4 billion, reflecting the disproportionate impact of higher international prices on the country’s energy import bill. The Indian crude oil basket averaged $119.91 per barrel in October, compared with $124.77 per barrel for Brent crude. In September, the Indian basket had averaged $116.09 per barrel, while Brent stood at $116.77 per barrel. The sustained increase in benchmark prices, amid continuing geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia, has left India exposed to higher energy procurement costs, given its dependence on imported crude oil. The impact of the rising crude import bill was partly offset by stronger earnings from petroleum product exports. India’s petroleum product exports increased 5.9% in volume terms to 5.4 MMT in October. However, export revenues surged approximately 91% to $6.3 billion.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The increase in export earnings provided an important buffer against the higher cost of crude procurement.

खरीद — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Procurement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘take some time’, says Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: He added that the deal can be signed only after the U.S. finalises its new tariff framework. Recently, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said the two nations had agreed that India would receive an advantage over its competitors

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The actual signing of the India-U.S. trade will still “take some time”, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), adding that the negotiation part and the legal text will be completed soon. The delay in signing, he said, was because it can be done only after the U.S. concludes its Section 301 investigations into its trade partners and finalises its tariff structure. A few days ago, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal asserted that the U.S. has acknowledged that India will receive lower tariffs as compared to its competitors. “This is a deal that has been announced in February, the contours have already been announced as part of the joint statement,” Mr. Agrawal said while speaking at the curtain raiser of the FICCI Annual General Meeting. “The legal agreement has also been negotiated and it is now in final stages and it will be concluded soon.” He was referring to the joint statement between India and the U.S. in February that announced the framework of an interim deal on trade. However, Mr. Agrawal explained that the “challenge” is that this framework was announced against the background of the executive tariffs system that the U.S. President Donald Trump had put in place. At the time, the tariff on India was 50%. Later in February, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down the legal foundation of these tariffs. “Now a new tariff architecture is being created by the U.S.,” Mr. Agrawal explained. “So until that tariff architecture comes back in place, the signing of a deal is something that I think will take some time. But concluding the negotiations and having everything ready will be something that we will strive to achieve as soon as possible.” In particular, Mr. Agrawal spoke about the investigations undertaken by the American administration under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974. One of these investigations, regarding forced labour, has been completed and a tariff of 10% has been levied on imports from India. The second investigation, looking into excess capacity, is yet to be completed and could come with further tariffs. “There are certain 301 investigations which are already under review,” Mr. Agrawal said. “Those will also be coming to the fore in the next few weeks or months. You can’t have a deal until you have got uncertainty around multiple investigations which are already there.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Separately, without mentioning the U.S. or any other country, Mr. Agrawal also asserted that trade deals can take a long time to conclude when parties try to maximise the benefits accruing to them rather than engaging in a spirit of compromise.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘take some time’, says Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
options: He added that the deal can be signed only after the U.S.
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘take s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘tak' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘tak' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: He added that the deal can be signed only after the U.S.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "He added that the deal can be signed only after the U.S." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा कि इस समझौते पर अमेरिका के बाद ही हस्ताक्षर किए जा सकते हैं।)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘take some time’, says Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Agrawal also asserted that trade deals can take a long time to conclude when parties try to maximise the benefits accruing to them rather than...
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Agrawal also asserted that trade deals can take a long time to conclude when parties try to maximise the benefits accruing to them rather than...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Agrawal also asserted that trade deals can take a long time to conclude when parties try to maximise the benefits accruing to them rather than..." (Hinglish Arth: अग्रवाल ने यह भी कहा कि व्यापार सौदों को संपन्न होने में लंबा समय लग सकता है जब पार्टियां समझौते की भावना में शामिल होने के बजाय उन्हें होने वाले लाभ को अधिकतम करने का प्रयास करती हैं।)

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #18 of 30 (18 NOV)

📰 India-U.S. trade deal signing will still ‘take some time’, says Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal

📌 Published: 18 Nov 2026, 05:23:30 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: He added that the deal can be signed only after the U.S. finalises its new tariff framework. Recently, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said the two nations had agreed that India would receive an advantage over its competitors

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The actual signing of the India-U.S. trade will still “take some time”, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), adding that the negotiation part and the legal text will be completed soon. The delay in signing, he said, was because it can be done only after the U.S. concludes its Section 301 investigations into its trade partners and finalises its tariff structure. A few days ago, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal asserted that the U.S. has acknowledged that India will receive lower tariffs as compared to its competitors. “This is a deal that has been announced in February, the contours have already been announced as part of the joint statement,” Mr. Agrawal said while speaking at the curtain raiser of the FICCI Annual General Meeting. “The legal agreement has also been negotiated and it is now in final stages and it will be concluded soon.” He was referring to the joint statement between India and the U.S. in February that announced the framework of an interim deal on trade. However, Mr. Agrawal explained that the “challenge” is that this framework was announced against the background of the executive tariffs system that the U.S. President Donald Trump had put in place. At the time, the tariff on India was 50%. Later in February, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down the legal foundation of these tariffs. “Now a new tariff architecture is being created by the U.S.,” Mr. Agrawal explained. “So until that tariff architecture comes back in place, the signing of a deal is something that I think will take some time. But concluding the negotiations and having everything ready will be something that we will strive to achieve as soon as possible.” In particular, Mr. Agrawal spoke about the investigations undertaken by the American administration under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974. One of these investigations, regarding forced labour, has been completed and a tariff of 10% has been levied on imports from India. The second investigation, looking into excess capacity, is yet to be completed and could come with further tariffs. “There are certain 301 investigations which are already under review,” Mr. Agrawal said. “Those will also be coming to the fore in the next few weeks or months. You can’t have a deal until you have got uncertainty around multiple investigations which are already there.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Separately, without mentioning the U.S. or any other country, Mr. Agrawal also asserted that trade deals can take a long time to conclude when parties try to maximise the benefits accruing to them rather than engaging in a spirit of compromise.

articles.title: U.K., E.U to announce youth mobility deal, as they discuss closer ties
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The two sides are expected to announce a scheme for 100,000 18-32 year olds to live and work across each other’s borders

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is expected to agree new terms for Britain’s relationship with the E.U. as he meets with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in Brussels on November 20 at a Summit meeting. Mr Burnham has said in recent weeks that Brexit had caused “more harm than good”. The two sides are expected to announce a scheme for 100,000 18-32 year olds to live and work across each other’s borders. In addition, they are working on closer ties in food and drink and linking the carbon trading schemes of the U.K. and the EU, as per reports. “There’s the possibility of lower food prices, I can’t turn my back on that,” Mr Burnham said. The summit is expected to announce the start of a dialogue on migration — including returns of irregular migrants to third countries. The deal is a significant step to closer ties but is not expected to be the post-Brexit “reset” with Brussels that the Labour Party has sought . Mr Burnham, who is taking forward some of the discussions held with Brussels by his predecessor Keir Starmer, has committed to keeping to the red lines outlined in the Labour 2024 manifesto for the duration of this parliament (2029). These red lines include not joining the bloc, nor its customs union and single market, and not allowing the “free movement” of people across UK-EU borders. However, Mr Burnham has said the U.K. would have to decide on its long-term options for its ties with the E.U. — including rejoining the E.U. The nature of the future relationship between the U.K. and E.U. is likely to be a campaign issue when Britain approaches its next general election. “Business across the country have been clear, our current deal with the EU is not good enough,” said UK minister for EU relations, Hamish Falconer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr Burnham had earlier said he would present legislation to the U.K. Parliament next week on this week’s agreements with Brussels. The U.K. will need harmonize some of its laws with the E.U.’s (i.e., follow them) to operationalize any deal on agriculture for instance.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 U.K., E.U to announce youth mobility deal, as they discuss closer ties

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 02:52:32 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The two sides are expected to announce a scheme for 100,000 18-32 year olds to live and work across each other’s borders

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is expected to agree new terms for Britain’s relationship with the E.U. as he meets with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in Brussels on November 20 at a Summit meeting. Mr Burnham has said in recent weeks that Brexit had caused “more harm than good”. The two sides are expected to announce a scheme for 100,000 18-32 year olds to live and work across each other’s borders. In addition, they are working on closer ties in food and drink and linking the carbon trading schemes of the U.K. and the EU, as per reports. “There’s the possibility of lower food prices, I can’t turn my back on that,” Mr Burnham said. The summit is expected to announce the start of a dialogue on migration — including returns of irregular migrants to third countries. The deal is a significant step to closer ties but is not expected to be the post-Brexit “reset” with Brussels that the Labour Party has sought . Mr Burnham, who is taking forward some of the discussions held with Brussels by his predecessor Keir Starmer, has committed to keeping to the red lines outlined in the Labour 2024 manifesto for the duration of this parliament (2029). These red lines include not joining the bloc, nor its customs union and single market, and not allowing the “free movement” of people across UK-EU borders. However, Mr Burnham has said the U.K. would have to decide on its long-term options for its ties with the E.U. — including rejoining the E.U. The nature of the future relationship between the U.K. and E.U. is likely to be a campaign issue when Britain approaches its next general election. “Business across the country have been clear, our current deal with the EU is not good enough,” said UK minister for EU relations, Hamish Falconer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr Burnham had earlier said he would present legislation to the U.K. Parliament next week on this week’s agreements with Brussels. The U.K. will need harmonize some of its laws with the E.U.’s (i.e., follow them) to operationalize any deal on agriculture for instance.

Possibility (Noun)
संभावना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Possibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

विधान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Legislation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Commission (Noun)
आयोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Commission' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Parliament (Adjective)
संसद — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Parliament' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "U.K., E.U to announce youth mobility deal, as they discuss closer ties", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The two sides are expected to announce a scheme for 100,000 18-32 year olds to live and work across each other’s borders.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'U.K., E.U to announce youth mobility deal, as th' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'U.K., E.U to announce youth mobility deal, as' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'U.K., E.U to announce youth mobility deal, as' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The two sides are expected to announce a scheme for 100,000 18-32 year olds to live and work across each other’s borders." ✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Myanmar calls ICJ ruling on genocide 'unfair'
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ruling by the ⁠International Court of Justice was the first time the court has held a ​State responsible for ‌genocide

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A ruling by the United ​Nations' highest court that found Myanmar's ‌security forces conducted State-sponsored genocide against ​the country's Rohingya ⁠Muslim minority was unfair, a Government official said on Friday (November 20, 2026). The decision was not ‌unanimous and Myanmar had been unjustly accused, said ‌Khaing Khaing Soe, a ‌Government ⁠spokesperson. Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya, says top UN court Rohingya in Bangladesh welcome UN court’s genocide verdict but say they want to go home to Myanmar The ruling by the ⁠International Court of Justice (ICJ) was the first time the court has held a State responsible for ‌genocide. It came seven years after the case was filed by predominantly Muslim Gambia. It was the ‌fourth time since the ​Nazi Holocaust that an international court ruled that the ⁠legal threshold to prove genocide had been met. "Our country was unjustly ‌accused," Mr. Khaing Soe told a press conference in the capital Naypyitaw. "I want to say that this decision is not a unanimous decision by ‌everyone, it is not fair." Judges found ​that Myanmar's military carried out mass executions of men ⁠and boys, committed widespread rape and ⁠sexual violence against Rohingya women and burned or razed ‌hundreds of villages during so-called clearance operations.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Myanmar / international court or tribunal / human rights

hinglishTracks.en: The ruling by the ⁠International Court of Justice was the first time the court has held a ​State responsible for ‌genocide
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ⁠अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय का फैसला पहली बार था जब अदालत ने नरसंहार के लिए किसी राज्य को जिम्मेदार ठहराया है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक सरकारी अधिकारी ने शुक्रवार (20 नवंबर, 2026) को कहा कि संयुक्त राष्ट्र की सर्वोच्च अदालत का फैसला जिसमें पाया गया कि म्यांमार के सुरक्षा बलों ने देश के रोहिंग्या मुस्लिम अल्पसंख्यकों के खिलाफ राज्य-प्रायोजित नरसंहार किया, अनुचित था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The decision was not ‌unanimous and Myanmar had been unjustly accused, said ‌Khaing Khaing Soe, a ‌Government ⁠spokesperson.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सरकार के प्रवक्ता खैंग खिंग सो ने कहा, निर्णय सर्वसम्मत नहीं था और म्यांमार पर अन्यायपूर्ण आरोप लगाया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Unanimous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: एकमत — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Unanimous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Khaing Soe told a press conference in the capital Naypyitaw.
