options: A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an...
Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'How AI could reshape global growth and productiv' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'How AI could reshape global growth and produc' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that 'How AI could reshape global growth and produc' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an..." (Hinglish Arth: एआई का एक प्रमुख अपेक्षित प्रभाव श्रम उत्पादकता में अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि है, क्योंकि तकनीकी क्रांति के रूप में इसकी सफलता इस तरह की वृद्धि पर आधारित है; देखने वाली बात यह है कि इसका प्रभाव पूरे देश में कितना व्यापक होगा)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "How AI could reshape global growth and productivity"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour." (Hinglish Arth: पाठ और संदर्भ/अर्थव्यवस्था/कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता/श्रम)

hinglishTracks.en: A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an increase; what remains to be seen is how pervasive its impact will be across different sectors of the economy
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एआई का एक प्रमुख अपेक्षित प्रभाव श्रम उत्पादकता में अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि है, क्योंकि तकनीकी क्रांति के रूप में इसकी सफलता इस तरह की वृद्धि पर आधारित है; देखने वाली बात यह है कि इसका अर्थव्यवस्था के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों पर कितना व्यापक प्रभाव पड़ेगा। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Technological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: तकनीकी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Technological' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Many have likened the artificial intelligence (AI) phenomenon to the inventions of the steam engine or internal combustion engine in the 18th and 19th centuries, respectively.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कई लोगों ने कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) घटना की तुलना क्रमशः 18वीं और 19वीं शताब्दी में भाप इंजन या आंतरिक दहन इंजन के आविष्कारों से की है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Intelligence' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बुद्धिमत्ता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intelligence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Only time can tell whether AI is epochal of that kind.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — केवल समय ही बता सकता है कि एआई उस तरह का युगप्रवर्तक है या नहीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: In this two-part piece, we discuss the possible impact it may have on the global economy as a whole.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इस दो-भाग वाले भाग में, हम समग्र रूप से वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था पर पड़ने वाले संभावित प्रभाव पर चर्चा करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: A key impact of AI is considered to be an unprecedented rise in labour productivity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एआई का एक प्रमुख प्रभाव श्रम उत्पादकता में अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि माना जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: In fact, if there is one purpose AI is supposed to serve, it is enhancing labour productivity multifold.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वास्तव में, अगर एआई को एक उद्देश्य पूरा करना है, तो वह श्रम उत्पादकता को कई गुना बढ़ाना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Since labour productivity is a key variable in this puzzle, consider what it constitutes of (Box 1) .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — चूँकि इस पहेली में श्रम उत्पादकता एक प्रमुख चर है, इसलिए विचार करें कि इसका क्या मतलब है (बॉक्स 1)।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.en: It is a ratio of output and workers employed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह उत्पादन और नियोजित श्रमिकों का अनुपात है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Now this ratio can rise in three different ways — a rise in output for a given number of workers employed (rise in the numerator); a loss of jobs which leads to a fall in the denominator; more jobs are created, but the output rises faster than the jobs (while both the numerator and the denominator are rising, the numerator rises faster than the denominator).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अब यह अनुपात तीन अलग-अलग तरीकों से बढ़ सकता है - नियोजित श्रमिकों की एक निश्चित संख्या के लिए उत्पादन में वृद्धि (अंश में वृद्धि); नौकरियों का नुकसान जिसके कारण भाजक में गिरावट आती है; अधिक नौकरियाँ पैदा होती हैं, लेकिन उत्पादन नौकरियों की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ता है (जबकि अंश और हर दोनों बढ़ रहे हैं, अंश हर की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ता है)।।

hinglishTracks.en: There is usually a distinction drawn between a case where there is a net loss of jobs versus one where jobs grow, but the output grows even faster.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — आम तौर पर उन मामलों के बीच अंतर किया जाता है जहां नौकरियों का शुद्ध नुकसान होता है बनाम जहां नौकरियां बढ़ती हैं, लेकिन उत्पादन और भी तेजी से बढ़ता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The latter is preferred over the former.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पहले की तुलना में बाद वाले को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Even though AI may displace white-collar workers, it may generate more jobs for the blue-collar workers, so in the net there may not be a job loss with AI adoption across the economy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भले ही एआई सफेदपोश श्रमिकों को विस्थापित कर सकता है, यह ब्लू-कॉलर श्रमिकों के लिए अधिक नौकरियां पैदा कर सकता है, इसलिए पूरे अर्थव्यवस्था में एआई को अपनाने से नौकरी का नुकसान नहीं हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, for the argument we make below, it does not matter which of the three sources leads to a rise in productivity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि, हम नीचे जो तर्क दे रहे हैं, उससे कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता कि तीनों में से किस स्रोत से उत्पादकता में वृद्धि होती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Why should the rise in labour productivity matter?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — श्रम उत्पादकता में वृद्धि क्यों मायने रखनी चाहिए?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: There are two contrasting takes on this question in the economics discipline.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अर्थशास्त्र अनुशासन में इस प्रश्न पर दो विरोधाभासी दृष्टिकोण हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: One which argues that productivity growth increases the growth of output in the economy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एक जो तर्क देता है कि उत्पादकता वृद्धि अर्थव्यवस्था में उत्पादन की वृद्धि को बढ़ाती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The idea is simple.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विचार सरल है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Growth of output is a function of its two inputs — labour and capital.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उत्पादन की वृद्धि इसके दो आदानों - श्रम और पूंजी का एक कार्य है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Since capital enhances the productivity of labour, the rate at which output can grow is the sum of the growth of the labour force and its productivity.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — चूँकि पूंजी श्रम की उत्पादकता को बढ़ाती है, जिस दर से उत्पादन बढ़ सकता है वह श्रम शक्ति की वृद्धि और उसकी उत्पादकता का योग है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: So, if the workforce grows at 2% and productivity at 4%, the economy would stabilise at 6% growth over time.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसलिए, यदि कार्यबल 2% और उत्पादकता 4% की दर से बढ़ती है, तो समय के साथ अर्थव्यवस्था 6% की वृद्धि पर स्थिर हो जाएगी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: And if the rate of labour productivity rises, according to this framework, growth in the economy rises pari passu (Graph 1a).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — और यदि श्रम उत्पादकता की दर बढ़ती है, तो इस ढांचे के अनुसार, अर्थव्यवस्था में वृद्धि समान रूप से बढ़ जाती है (ग्राफ़ 1ए)।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Between the three variables — output growth, labour growth and productivity growth — output growth adjusts to the other two.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #16 of 30 (18 NOV)

📰 How AI could reshape global growth and productivity

📌 Published: 18 Nov 2026, 11:54:05 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A key expected impact of AI is an unprecedented rise in labour productivity, as its success as a technological revolution is premised on such an increase; what remains to be seen is how pervasive its impact will be across different sectors of the economy

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Many have likened the artificial intelligence (AI) phenomenon to the inventions of the steam engine or internal combustion engine in the 18th and 19th centuries, respectively. Only time can tell whether AI is epochal of that kind. In this two-part piece, we discuss the possible impact it may have on the global economy as a whole. A key impact of AI is considered to be an unprecedented rise in labour productivity. In fact, if there is one purpose AI is supposed to serve, it is enhancing labour productivity multifold. Since labour productivity is a key variable in this puzzle, consider what it constitutes of (Box 1) . It is a ratio of output and workers employed. Now this ratio can rise in three different ways — a rise in output for a given number of workers employed (rise in the numerator); a loss of jobs which leads to a fall in the denominator; more jobs are created, but the output rises faster than the jobs (while both the numerator and the denominator are rising, the numerator rises faster than the denominator). There is usually a distinction drawn between a case where there is a net loss of jobs versus one where jobs grow, but the output grows even faster. The latter is preferred over the former. Even though AI may displace white-collar workers, it may generate more jobs for the blue-collar workers, so in the net there may not be a job loss with AI adoption across the economy. However, for the argument we make below, it does not matter which of the three sources leads to a rise in productivity. Why should the rise in labour productivity matter? There are two contrasting takes on this question in the economics discipline. One which argues that productivity growth increases the growth of output in the economy. The idea is simple. Growth of output is a function of its two inputs — labour and capital. Since capital enhances the productivity of labour, the rate at which output can grow is the sum of the growth of the labour force and its productivity. So, if the workforce grows at 2% and productivity at 4%, the economy would stabilise at 6% growth over time. And if the rate of labour productivity rises, according to this framework, growth in the economy rises pari passu (Graph 1a). Between the three variables — output growth, labour growth and productivity growth — output growth adjusts to the other two. This is what Robert Solow, a celebrated economist and a Nobel laureate, showed in a seminal paper on growth theory. What he did not explain though was why and where did this labour productivity rise come from. Much later, his successors argued that the growth of labour productivity depends on investment in human capital, research and development, patent regimes, etc., what came to be known as endogenous growth theories.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour

D. The author contends that 'How AI could reshape global growth and produc' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. B. Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour.

D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Text and Context / economy / Artificial Intelligence / labour." (Hinglish Arth: पाठ और संदर्भ/अर्थव्यवस्था/कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता/श्रम)

dailyQuiz10.explanation:
1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: New Zealand at home remains an indomitable cricketing opposition. Even the great West Indian squad led by Clive Lloyd suffered a 0-1 Test series defeat in 1980. Pitches that look lush as English meadows, the wind that is often bone-chilling cold, and fast bowlers relishing their prospects, make any tour of New Zealand a difficult outing. So far, the visiting Indians have done well, having won the T20I and ODI series, but the real contest starts with the first Test at Wellington’s Basin Reserve from Thursday. The Shubman Gill-led men’s last overseas tour of Sri Lanka ended with a middling 1-0 victory in the two Tests, but more needs to be done against New Zealand in the latest two-Test series. Placed fourth in the ICC World Test Championship (WTC) table, and with hopes of securing a final berth seemingly fragile, India is in a win-all-games situation first up against New Zealand and later when Australia arrives next year. Against current WTC topper New Zealand, the Indian batters have to stay anchored. This is a line-up that no longer has Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane. Gill and company get another opportunity to reiterate their credentials.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For some rugged inspiration they need not look beyond coach Gautam Gambhir in their dressing room. The doughty former India opener batted for 643 minutes while scoring a match-saving 137 in the Napier Test during the 2009 tour. The southpaw will be hoping that the current batting unit, which is high on flair, will remain sober and effectively counter the host. K.L. Rahul, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Devdutt Padikkal and Gill have the onerous task of negating the New Zealand seamers in their backyard. Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel add depth, and if the former can successfully unleash his maverick batting approach, India can upset the host’s best-laid plans. New Zealand will miss the retired Kane Williamson but its batters would be comfortable on familiar surfaces. For India, much would hinge on how Jasprit Bumrah bowls. If the spearhead clicks, then it becomes easier for much of his support-cast that includes the persevering Mohammed Siraj, who was a touch rusty in Sri Lanka. From the squads of the past to the present unit, Ravindra Jadeja remains the link. Whether he will get a role to play or whether the management prefers an all-pace attack, remains a matter of conjecture. The home team led by Tom Latham will depend on Matt Henry, Kyle Jameson and other pacers, to choke the Indian batters. A hard task awaits India, first at Wellington and then at Christchurch.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Each year, the summits of the 11-member Association of South-East Asian Nations mark an important moment on the diplomatic calendar: India is able to interact with all of its partners in the Indo-Pacific and engage global powers at the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit. Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s talks with Indo-Pacific players focused on a future shaped “not by competition, but by cooperation”. This year, the summit in Manila hosted by the Philippines had many other imperatives. These were the first ASEAN summits since the U.S.-Israel attacks on Iran and Iran’s Hormuz blockade and strikes on Gulf countries that have upended energy and trade across South and South East Asia. Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s call for “peace, stability, and predictability” in the world during the EAS was aimed as much at leaders from the U.S., Russia and China as it was for the region. The visit had a bilateral context — the Philippines and India have intensified ties considerably in the past year, since the visit of President Bongbong Marcos to Delhi in August 2025, including the upgradation of the Strategic Partnership, maritime exchanges and negotiations over the supply of more Indian-made Brahmos missile battery systems to the Philippines. This year, after months of concerns about U.S. President Donald Trump’s lack of interest in the Quad grouping, the U.S. decided to host a summit of U.S.-India-Australia-Japan Quad leaders on the side-lines of the ASEAN summits, the first time the summit has been held in a non-Quad country.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Given the stakes, there were several outcomes from all the three summits that PM Modi attended back-to-back on Tuesday — the ASEAN India Summit launched a new cooperation on disaster management, and the East Asia Summit focused on countering cyber-crime. PM Modi’s announcement that India would give all ASEAN citizens free tourist visas is expected to increase people-to-people interactions and trade. At the Quad summit, President Trump made a number of announcements including the launch of a Quad Business leaders forum, to be held in Mumbai next year, and the first Quad naval exercises with patrol aircraft. However, the outcomes in Manila paled in significance to the anticipation over Mr. Trump’s next stop in Shenzhen for the Asia Pacific Economic Conference (APEC), with an unprecedented three-way summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping planned on Thursday. New Delhi must watch the outcomes of that summit among the “global superpowers” much more closely.

1. Core Context & Background: Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Three months of lull established by security forces in Jammu and Kashmir was rattled by the back-to-back incidents of violence in the past six days. On November 11, a terror attack on a checkpoint manned by the personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in Kulgam left three jawans injured. On November 16, a local, whom the police suspected of having joined the terror ranks a few days ago, was killed after six days of a siege-like anti-terror operation in residential areas of Kulgam. In Jammu’s Kishtwar, two Special Police Officers (SPOs) of the J&K Police were found dead with bullet wounds, a day after they were reported missing in a forest range on November 11. The police and the Army, however, remain tight-lipped about the circumstances around the killing of these SPOs, and there are conflicting reports on the circumstances that led to their deaths. The anti-terror operation in civilian areas of Kulgam has raised concerns. Former J&K Chief Minister and PDP president Mehbooba Mufti described the operation, spread over six days, as “collective punishment that only breeds alienation and resentment,” while NC spokesman Imran Nabi Dar suggested that entire villages were put under prolonged restrictions for days. The Omar Abdullah government , because of limited powers and no jurisdiction over the police in J&K, a Union Territory since 2019, finds itself hamstrung. The iron hand policy to stamp out terrorism and separatism has been effective from a strictly security perspective — terror attacks as well as local recruitments into terror ranks have declined. According to the police, local recruits have come down to single digit or fewer than 10 in Kashmir.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: That said, the decline in terrorist incidents and the silence of the streets should not be mistaken for peace. The current situation demands a political reach-out by the Centre to all the stakeholders of J&K. It has to begin with the much-promised restoration of Statehood , which will give the voters a sense that their mass participation in the 2024 Assembly elections allowed their elected leaders to hold institutions accountable, and they were able to work freely to protect the interests of the region. Though the security agencies need to be focused on Pakistan-backed terrorism, it should not come at the cost of re-inflicting psychological scars within Kashmir, which could turn into a powder keg if left unattended. Healing through both political and security processes has to be complementary rather than conflicting. Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.

dailyQuiz10.explanation:
1. Core Context & Background: Death penalty requires a near-infallible criminal justice system

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s vote against a proposed global moratorium on the death penalty at the UN is consistent with its position at the forum; it has defended its retention of the penalty as a sovereign decision backed by judicial safeguards, including the “rarest of rare” condition and sessions courts’ sentences requiring a High Court’s confirmation. At the same time, the Supreme Court has increasingly restricted capital punishment and research has failed to find evidence of additional deterrence over life imprisonment . India’s distinction between judicial executions and extrajudicial killings is legally valid but its further claim that due process protects people facing execution is less so. While India last executed convicts in 2020, for the Delhi gang-rape and murder, Parliament expanded the number of capital offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita — a form of penal populism that projects the political attractiveness of the state’s response to public outrage, especially in cases of sexual violence, without addressing the poor policing and low conviction rates that actually undermine deterrence . The country had 574 people on death row on December 31, 2025, the highest since 2016, thanks to trial court rulings, challenging claims about judicial safeguards in practice. The report of the 2015 Law Commission headed by Justice A.P. Shah said the death penalty “fails to achieve any constitutionally valid penological goals” and recommended abolishing it for all crimes except terrorism and waging war. Only a small group of countries worldwide are executing more people. In India, per Project 39A, the Supreme Court released 38 persons from death row in 2016-2025 after they had spent eight years there on average. Some have endured more than two decades. The punishment requires a measure of infallibility that the criminal justice system cannot supply. The safeguards neither deter convictions in cases with flawed evidence, false testimony, and so on nor remedy unequal access to competent legal representation among those facing the penalty. India should formally suspend executions and commission a review of penalty statutes and the treatment of prisoners on death row. Second, it should spare offences that do not involve intentional killing from the penalty. Research suggests meting out excessively harsh punishments for non-fatal crimes could incentivise offenders to escalate their violence, including to kill potential witnesses. The greater goal should be to abolish the practice in law while improving investigative and prosecutorial practices and access to legal aid.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: prison / judiciary (system of justice) / crime, law and justice / United Nations / death penalty policies

In a communication to all district collectors, T. Prabushankar, Director of Geology and Mining, said accidents involving unprotected abandoned quarries, some resulting in loss of life, had been reported in recent times, which was a matter of grave concern. Such quarries, particularly deep excavations that accumulate rainwater during the monsoon, pose a risk of drowning or accidental falls for locals, children, pedestrians, and grazing livestock. The State government has ordered that durable perimeter fencing be erected around all abandoned quarries on government and patta lands. For abandoned quarries on government lands, the district collectors have been asked to utilise the Green Fund constituted under the Tamil Nadu Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1959, or any other available district funds to complete the fencing works as a priority within a period of two months. The State government also directed District Officers of Geology and Mining to conduct a comprehensive field verification of all abandoned quarries on patta lands to ensure proper fencing has been erected by the respective ex-lessees at their own cost. In cases where ex-lessees have failed to comply, immediate notices shall be issued and stringent enforcement action shall be initiated, the communication said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: It also said prominent warning signboards in Tamil and English, clearly identifying the site as an abandoned quarry, specifying its depth and warning against trespassing, shall be displayed along the perimeter.

Lokanadham said nearly 1,800 acres of assigned land had been taken over in the Amaravati region for capital development. The leaders said that when Amaravati was established in 2014, assigned landowners had also surrendered their lands along with other farmers, based on assurances that they would receive annual lease payments and residential and commercial plots on a par with owners of patta lands. However, these assurances had not been fulfilled so far, they alleged. The landowners were facing severe livelihood difficulties as they had lost their agricultural land and had no alternative means of employment. The government had a responsibility to provide them relief at least by clearing the pending lease payments, the union leaders said.

Odisha Assembly Speaker Surama Padhy on Friday (November 23) adjourned the proceedings of the House till November 23 morning due to Cyclone Akvan, which made landfall near Gopalpur during the day. The decision was taken at an all-party meeting, following which Padhy announced the adjournment. During the meeting, it was decided that legislators should assist people to overcome the adverse impact of Cyclone Akvan, she said. Odisha Assembly adjourned until November 23 morning due to Cyclone Akvan, with two-day recess for MLAs to assist affected constituencies.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan has begun interacting with the land along the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coast, bringing heavy rainfall and disrupting transport services.
